name: scrummaster-fossil-mcp
description: MCP server wrapping all of Scrummaster's Fossil access: generic VCS operations (status/diff/commit/revert/etc.), the wiki (the primary store for scrummaster docs, registries, specs, plans, and metadata), and Fossil ticket / ACID operations. Ticket handling adapted from the acid-cli fossil client; plan.md [x] markers remain the source of truth for completion.
